questions.q: Whose spirit did Yahweh stir up to make a proclamation through all his kingdom?
questions.evidence: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia

questions.q: When the foundation was laid, what did the old men who had seen the first house do?
questions.evidence: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice

questions.q: What did the people do when the foundation of Yahweh's house was laid?
questions.evidence: All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahweh, because the foundation of Yahweh’s house had been laid

questions.q: How did the people keep the dedication of the rebuilt house of God?
questions.evidence: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy

questions.q: What was Ezra, who went up from Babylon?
questions.evidence: He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which Yahweh, the God of Israel, had given

questions.q: What did the people agree to make a covenant to put away?
questions.evidence: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and those who as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God
